summary: Quantitative Advisor - Model Risk Management candidate with ~7 years across model governance, derivatives-pricing validation, and quantitative risk analytics. Operates within a formal model-governance framework at Moody's Analytics with delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs, independently reviewing pricing models' conceptual soundness, curve calibration, and cross-asset behavior against SR 11-7-aligned standards. Python-fluent, with derivatives (rates, FX, inflation) and stochastic/Monte Carlo depth. CFA charterholder and dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering).

sections.heading: Model Governance, Review & Certification
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; $50bn+ cumulative) - independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Operate within a formal model-governance framework as a member of the model governance committee, reviewing methodology, benchmarking standards, assumption validity, and model-performance assessment consistent with SR 11-7-aligned expectations.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Pricing-Model Validation & Risk Metrics
bullets: Validate derivatives pricing models across rates, FX, and inflation - cross-checking sensitivity consistency and scenario impacts at portfolio-level risk aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream risk and capital processes.
Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, reviewing conceptual soundness and accuracy of the underlying methodology.

sections.heading: Monitoring Methodology & Tooling
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and documentation controls.

Built agentic-AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection - reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Prepared analytical documentation and summaries for senior stakeholders on exposure, scenario impacts, and sensitivities, meeting internal governance and documentation standards.

Served as technical liaison between institutional client investment teams and product/development functions - translating quantitative requirements into structured development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms across the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and contributing to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions on milestone delivery and implementation materials.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators for stress testing of interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients; presented findings to investment committees.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
